sources.quote: I'm really enjoying playing Creator Chronicles, but I wanted to share some feedback regarding the economy in the game. Currently, building or upgrading houses costs an absolute fortune. At the same time, earning money takes a significant amount of time and effort. This makes progression feel a bit discouraging, as it takes forever just to afford a single new home. Could the developers please consider rebalancing the economy? Lowering the construction costs or slightly increasing the income rates would make the game much more enjoyable and balanced. Thanks for reading!
